title: 4 CD Lot Jazz Broadway Phil Norman Tentet Tom Talbert Septet Wicked Cast
descriptionText:
Description

Lot of 4 pre-owned CDs featuring jazz and Broadway music.

Includes:

* The Phil Norman Tentet – On The Town — Sea Breeze Jazz, SB-3022
* The Phil Norman Tentet – Encore — MAMA Records, MAA 1040
* Tom Talbert Septet – Things As They Are — Sea Breeze Jazz, CD-SB-2038
* Wicked: A New Musical – Original Broadway Cast Album — Decca Broadway, B0001682-02, 2003

The Wicked recording features the original Broadway cast including Idina Menzel, Kristin Chenoweth, Norbert Leo Butz, and Joel Grey.

All four CDs, jewel cases, and pictured inserts/artwork are included. Items are pre-owned and may show normal cosmetic wear from age and storage. Discs show some light surface wear consistent with use. Please review all photos carefully for exact condition and contents.

You will receive the exact CDs pictured.

Item specifics

Format: CD
Genre: Jazz / Musical / Cast Recording
Type: Album
Language: English
Number of CDs: 4
Case Type: Jewel Case
Condition: Pre-Owned
Features: Original Cast Recording, Jazz Ensemble
